issues.description: Animal is specified in the UML/problem statement as having only the attribute "name: String" (and constructors should initialize all class attributes), but the solution adds an additional attribute "age: int" with getters/setters. This changes the required state of Animal compared to the specification and can confuse students about what fields must exist.
issues.suggestedFix: Align artifacts by either (a) removing the age field and its getters/setters from the solution so Animal only has name, or (b) updating the UML/problem statement to include age as an Animal attribute (and mention its getter/setter requirement).

issues.description: Constructors for Animal subclasses are inconsistent with the provided example and UML intent. The template Main shows one-argument constructors (e.g., new Seal("Clarabelle")), but the solution defines constructors for Seal/Pig/Goat requiring (String name, int age) (via Animal(String,int)). This makes the provided example code incompatible and will block students if they follow it.
issues.suggestedFix: Make constructors consistent across spec/template/solution: either change solution constructors to accept only (String name), or update the template Main example and problem statement to consistently use (String name, int age) and document the age parameter.
